newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber quiet as sellers seek orders.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber quiet as sellers seek orders.

text.p: Trading in the Singapore rubber market was quiet by midday on Thursday with sellers actively seeking orders from consumers sitting on the sidelines, dealers said.
"It was a bit flat this morning. There are a lot of sellers around trying to offer but there were very few takers this morning," a dealer said.
Traders said the abundance of sellers in the market forced prices to be marked easier by the midday break although no deals were actually done.
Steady prices in Japan failed to give any leads to the market with the key November contract in Tokyo almost stationary, shedding 0.2 yen to 137.5 yen.
"As usual, people are waiting for the afternoon before deciding to do anything. The level of trade should pick up much later," one trader said.
At 0945 GMT, July RSS3 was indicated at at 115.75 U.S. cents a kg from the previous 116.75 cents. July RSS1 was indicated at 165.00 Singapore cents (US$1.15) a kg from 166.25 cents.
July TSR20 was indicated at 153.00 Singapore cents (US$1.07) a kg from 155.00 cents.-(S$1.43 = US$1) Rene Pastor (65-8703305)
